artboards.title: A — how the dense content behaves

annotations.text:
Four directions, four different feelings — not four shades of one.

Nothing here reuses the current palette, type or section rhythm. Pick the one that feels right and I build it out; the other three get deleted.

The answer to "large type and empty space, but all the SEO content": one idea per screen.

Every word stays in the DOM, so the schema and rankings are untouched. What changes is pacing — the eight deliverables get a whole viewport instead of a crowded card. Thirteen sections become thirteen moments.
All four drop three.js, GSAP and ScrollTrigger — 167KB of CDN JavaScript the current homepage loads before it paints.
